claims: Assess and treat pain, as patient reports worst pain 10/10.
Obtain repeat arterial blood gas to reassess acid-base status, given prior pH 7.30, bicarbonate 16 mEq/L, and base excess -5.
Monitor and correct hypocalcemia, with total calcium 7.6-7.8 mg/dL.
Monitor and correct hypomagnesemia, with magnesium 1.3 mg/dL.
Continue mechanical ventilation with current settings, given intubation and ventilator dependence.
Continue ampicillin-sulbactam for infection coverage, given leukocytosis (WBC 15.1-16.2 K/uL).
Maintain sedation at goal RASS 0 to -1 and reassess sedation level.
Perform oral care with chlorhexidine gluconate 0.12% oral rinse.
Reposition and turn patient every 2 hours, given bedfast status and pressure ulcer risk.
Monitor blood glucose, with recent glucose 151 mg/dL.
